# One module per case, st-<case>.yang, compiled with st-base.yang, whose
# definitions are deprecated or obsolete. scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh and
# scripts/pyang-oracle.sh record what yanglint and pyang say about each;
# test/compile/status.test.ts checks that @node-net/yang reports what is given here
# (once, at the referring statement), and compares with both.
#   case  expected: ok or warning:<code>
typedef                 warning:status-reference                # a current leaf uses a deprecated typedef
typedef-obsolete        warning:status-reference                # a current leaf uses an obsolete typedef
deprecated-to-obsolete  warning:status-reference                # a deprecated leaf uses an obsolete typedef
typedef-chain           warning:status-reference                # a current typedef derived from a deprecated one
union-member            warning:status-reference                # a deprecated typedef as a union member
nested-typedef          warning:status-reference                # nested typedefs: one inherits its container's status, one has its own
grouping                warning:status-reference                # a current uses of a deprecated grouping
grouping-twice          warning:status-reference                # a bad reference in a grouping used twice is reported once
identity-base           warning:status-reference                # a current identity derived from a deprecated one
identityref             warning:status-reference                # an identityref with a deprecated base
if-feature              warning:status-reference                # if-feature naming a deprecated feature
if-feature-or           warning:status-reference                # a deprecated feature after 'or', which evaluation never reaches
feature-if-feature      warning:status-reference                # a current feature's if-feature names a deprecated feature
enum-if-feature         warning:status-reference                # an enum's if-feature names a deprecated feature
leafref                 warning:status-reference                # a leafref to a leaf in a deprecated container
augment                 warning:status-reference                # a current augment of a deprecated container
must                    warning:status-reference                # a must selects a deprecated container
when                    warning:status-reference                # a when selects a deprecated container
ok-same-status          ok                                      # deprecated to deprecated, obsolete to deprecated
ok-inherited            ok                                      # references from inside a deprecated container
ok-inherited-uses       ok                                      # a uses of a deprecated grouping inside a deprecated container
ok-in-grouping          ok                                      # references from inside a deprecated grouping
ok-unused-grouping      ok                                      # a grouping nothing uses isn't compiled, so isn't checked
ok-current              ok                                      # a deprecated leaf uses a current typedef
other-typedef           warning:status-reference-other-module   # the same, into another module
other-obsolete          warning:status-reference-other-module
other-grouping          warning:status-reference-other-module
other-identityref       warning:status-reference-other-module
other-feature           warning:status-reference-other-module
other-leafref           warning:status-reference-other-module
other-augment           warning:status-reference-other-module
other-when              warning:status-reference-other-module
ok-deviation            ok                                      # deviating a deprecated node isn't a status reference
ok-other-inherited      ok                                      # references into another module from deprecated definitions
